about: Leonardo DiCaprio Pointing is a dim, cozy frame of DiCaprio as Rick Dalton in Quentin Tarantino's Once Upon a Time in Hollywood (2019): he sits back in a leather armchair, feet up, cigarette and a can of beer in one hand, stretching the other arm out to jab a finger at the TV with a delighted look. It is the face of someone who just recognized something on screen. As a meme it is the reaction for that jolt of excited recognition: spotting a reference, an in-joke, a familiar face, or yourself in a meme.
origin: In the film, Rick watches one of his own TV appearances and eagerly points at the screen when he shows up. The frame spread as a reaction image after the film's release in July 2019.
usage:
There is a single box at the top. Write a "when" or "me when" line describing the moment you spot something you recognize: a reference from your favourite show, your hometown in a movie, a song you know playing in a store, a bug you have seen before.

Keep the caption short; the pointing does the punchline. It also works as a straight reply image under any post that reminds you of something specific.
ideas: when the meme is about me
when the movie references the book
me spotting my hometown in a tv show
when the error message is one I've seen before
when the stadium plays my song
me seeing a character from another game in a cameo
